# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [재고 부족을 뒤늦게 알아차리시나요? 재고·발주 자동 알림 만들기](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/inventory-reorder-automation/): A practical guide to automatically tracking inventory levels and sales velocity to trigger reorder alerts before stockouts or overstock happen.
- [네이버·배달앱 리뷰, 매일 일일이 확인하고 계신가요? 자동 모니터링 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/review-rating-monitoring-automation/): A practical guide to automatically collecting store reviews across platforms like Naver, Google and delivery apps, prioritizing negative reviews and alerting staff.
- [업계 뉴스·공시, 매일 검색하고 계신가요? 자동 모니터링 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/news-monitoring-automation/): A practical guide to automating industry news and public disclosure monitoring with keyword collection, AI relevance judgment and prioritized alerts.
- [전화·이메일 예약 확인, 이제는 AI로 자동화하세요](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/reservation-booking-automation/): A practical guide to using AI to parse phone and email booking requests and automatically connect them to calendar checks and customer confirmations.
- [여러 시스템 숫자가 다르게 나온다면? 데이터 정합성 자동 점검 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-consistency-check-automation/): A practical guide to detecting mismatched numbers across ERP, CRM and spreadsheets by defining baselines, comparison rules and automated alerts.
- [AI 자동화 견적이 업체마다 다른 이유: 비용을 결정하는 5가지 요소](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-automation-cost-estimate-factors/): A practical guide to how integrations, data quality, AI scope, exception handling and production operations determine automation project cost.
- [자동화한다고 무조건 AI가 필요한 건 아닙니다: 규칙 자동화와 AI를 나누는 기준](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/automation-vs-ai-where-to-use-ai/): A practical guide to using deterministic automation for fixed rules and AI only where language, context or ambiguous judgment is required.
- [문의폼만 받아두고 있나요? 홈페이지 문의를 CRM·알림·후속 연락까지 자동화하는 방법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/lead-form-crm-automation/): How to turn website inquiries into a measurable sales workflow with centralized storage, routing, notifications, follow-up reminders and optional AI classification.
- [API가 없는 사내 시스템도 자동화할 수 있을까? 연결 방법 4가지](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/legacy-system-automation-without-api/): Practical ways to connect legacy ERP, groupware and admin systems without official APIs using files, read-only database access, browser automation and middleware APIs.
- [AI 자동화 상담 전에 이것부터 그려보세요: 업무 흐름 한 장 정리법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-automation-workflow-map/): A beginner-friendly method for mapping a business process into input, processing, decision, output and exception steps before choosing automation or AI.
